eligibility: Create an account and API key; the official 2026 hackathon guide confirms no card is needed.
overage: The pricing FAQ offers manual or automatic early renewal; check account renewal settings.
notes: Successful searches count; cached, failed and errored searches do not. Result count does not change the search unit.

eligibility: Not confirmed; consult provider signup and regional terms.
overage: New queries stop when credits reach zero; only successful responses consume credits.

name: Parallel Personal MCP
allowance: Free personal web search and fetch with variable limits; no fixed public quota.
eligibility: Personal use through the free hosted MCP server.
overage: Variable personal-use limits apply; paid API access is separate.
notes: Personal MCP access is distinct from Developer API billing and its card-backed monthly credit.

name: Keenable Search API
allowance: 100,000 requests/month per organization; search and fetch each consume one credit.
eligibility: Create an organization and API key; no card needed for the free allowance.
overage: Returns 402 without credits. Optional auto top-up can charge immediately when enabled below its threshold; leave it off for a free-only budget.
notes: Resets on the organization creation day (last day in shorter months). 10 RPS per organization. Paid usage after the allowance is $4/1K; not a guaranteed performance or uptime claim. Credit prices can be organization-specific; read the returned usage rather than assuming every operation always costs one credit.

name: Keenable keyless access
allowance: Shared pool of 1,000 requests/hour per IP per endpoint; 10 RPS.
eligibility: No API key or account; capacity shared by callers on the same public IP.
overage: Hourly limits apply; 429 responses include retry guidance.
notes: Anonymous access is separate from the account monthly grant and from paid x402 calls. Shared hosting shares the IP pool. HTTP, MCP and CLI can be tried without an account.

name: Search1API
allowance: 100 signup credits, no expiry; no monthly replenishment.
eligibility: Check provider signup and regional terms.
overage: Returns 402 when balance cannot cover a request. Auto top-up is optional and off by default.
notes: Basic search, news or crawl costs one credit; agentic search five; deep crawl twenty. Additional page extraction changes the cost.

name: Gemini Google Search grounding
allowance: Gemini 3+ paid tier: first 5,000 search requests/month shared across models; search fee only.
eligibility: Eligible Gemini paid-tier project and supported model; billing required.
overage: Above the search grant, search fees plus model token fees apply.
notes: This is not a zero-cost LLM pipeline: model tokens are billed. Search queries beyond the grant cost $14/1K. Free-tier availability varies by model; do not apply a legacy model allowance to every Gemini model. Default daily cap: 1,500 search queries/project; one prompt can trigger multiple billed queries.

name: Claude Web Search
allowance: No standard recurring free search allowance confirmed.
eligibility: Check provider signup and regional terms.
overage: Tool invocations and model tokens are billed.
notes: Official API price is $10/1K searches plus token usage; failed searches are not billed. Free chat access is not a free developer API.

notes: Standard web_search: $10/1K calls plus search-content tokens at model rates. Preview variants differ; free search-content tokens on some previews do not make the tool call free.

name: Ceramic Search
allowance: 1,000 free queries at signup; no recurring reset promised.
eligibility: Create an account and generate an API key. Regional or identity restrictions not confirmed.
overage: Further pay-as-you-go usage is priced at $0.25/1K queries. Exhaustion behavior and automatic payment settings are not confirmed.
notes: Official quickstart calls the signup grant 1,000 credits; pricing calls it 1,000 queries. Treat it as a one-time starter allowance. Free-credit expiry is not stated; Pro monthly resets do not establish a recurring free grant. Pay-as-you-go plan lists 20 QPS per organization.
